slices.focus: Training cohort redesigned into low-disruption format
slices.summary: Rather than abandoning the training effort after Judge Baca's rollback, Lucia redesigns it into a narrower format: short pre-docket observation windows instead of longer shadow blocks, after-hours terminology drills, and competency checklists that document progress by specific markers (accuracy, register, pace, error handling). She reframes the program from 'reduced version' to 'observation-and-competency track,' with a clear distinction between what the checklist can assess and what still requires full live pressure testing. The conversation emphasizes adaptation over surrender — she kept the backup pipeline alive by making it harder to target as an operational obstacle.
